service.method: SELECT s1.CTRL_NAME_LOC, s.ADD_DATE, s.REPRESENT_CTRL, s.CTRL_CODE, s.COMPANY_CODE FROM SBALN s, SBAGL s1 WHERE s.house_code=s1.house_code AND s.company_code=s1.company_code AND s.CTRL_CODE=s1.CTRL_CODE AND s.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND s.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND s.CTRL_PERSON_ID = ${USER_ID} ORDER BY s.CTRL_CODE
